build_policy.baked_in_fees_and_spread: zero; costs are applied by the replay
build_policy.builder: trade_rl.evaluation.dev_realdata_study.dataset_build gap policy and 4h/1d aggregation, run on the FS1 span
build_policy.exchange_information: exchange-rule snapshot recorded in the seal record, applied statically
build_policy.higher_clock_after_gap: window with any missing 1h bar is a price-carried placeholder with available_at=range end; recursive/rolling features touching it are unavailable
build_policy.higher_clock_source: 4h and 1d bars aggregated from complete 1h windows
build_policy.missing_base_bar_funding: funding events inside a missing bar are not accrued
build_policy.network: only the separately authorized FS1 data fetch; never while scoring

claim_limits: FS1 tests three configurations that were selected from public development results; it can falsify them out of sample but cannot re-select or tune them

one window of about 181 days: a single regime, about nine independent 20-day blocks; a FORWARD_FAIL from a wide interval means 'not demonstrated', not 'proved zero edge', and a FORWARD_PASS is not a durable-edge or profitability claim

FORWARD_PASS is only the minimum bar: max drawdown within 20% in base and cost x2 AND the 95% block-bootstrap lower bound of annualised daily excess over CASH at cost x2 is positive. An arm can be FORWARD_PASS and NO_BETTER_THAN_PASSIVE

the HEADLINE flag is edge_claim_supported: true only for FORWARD_PASS together with BETTER_THAN_PASSIVE (95% lower bound of the excess over FS1-C at cost x2 above zero) and survives_bonferroni_k2 (Bonferroni k=2 lower bound over CASH at cost x2 above zero). Without it the result supports no claim that the forecast or allocation mechanism adds value
CASH earns no yield; costs are the fixed assumptions of the frozen protocol (allocator c_i is a lower bound; participation impact is charged by the executor)
this is not the final-evaluation authorization chain, creates no WINNER and does not establish deployment (G5) eligibility; no live or paper order is placed

deviations: FS1 reuses the Phase 3 arm builders, runner and metrics unchanged; only the window, the arm roster, the Bonferroni count and the causality cut differ

the Ridge forecast sources refit every 30 days from the scoring start, expanding from the first dataset row; every refit uses only labels matured before its fit time, including bars of the scoring window that precede that fit time
bars of the warmup-only window feed features, forecasts and covariance warmup but are never scored: the replay starts at the scoring start row
CASH is the all-zero book and earns no interest

seal_procedure: 1 this module is merged through the normal review path; no data exists
2 a fresh result-blind G0-G2 review of the design record and code is recorded on the merging change before the seal
3 the seal record on Issue #810 names the sealed code commit, the params digest above and, later, the dataset manifest SHA-256
4 the user separately authorises (a) fetching the post-2026-08-31 data and (b) the single scoring run, each by an Issue #810 comment
5 the seal record also names the dataset builder commit and command, the exchange-rule snapshot and the UTC fetch time; the manifest carries the build policy digest and the fetch time

6 the dataset manifest is recorded before scoring; scoring refuses on any mismatch, before the scoring end plus the settlement margin, without an Issue #810 authorization comment URL or when the output already exists
